statusLine.command:
input=$(cat)
# Parse each field separately: `// empty` inside an array collapses it and shifts columns.
model=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // ""' 2>/dev/null)
pct=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // ""' 2>/dev/null)
size=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.context_window_size // ""' 2>/dev/null)
transcript=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.transcript_path // ""' 2>/dev/null)
[ -z "$model" ] && model=unknown
case "$size" in ''|*[!0-9]*) size=200000 ;; esac
# Backend: env vars are inherited from the parent Claude Code process.
if [ -n "$CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK" ] && [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK" != 0 ]; then backend='AWS Bedrock'
elif [ -n "$CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX" ] && [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX" != 0 ]; then backend='GCP Vertex'
elif [ -n "$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" ]; then backend='API'
else backend='Claude'; fi
# Context usage: prefer the payload field, else sum the last usage record in the transcript.
if [ -z "$pct" ] && [ -n "$transcript" ] && [ -f "$transcript" ]; then
  usage=$(jq -c 'select(.message.usage != null) | .message.usage' "$transcript" 2>/dev/null | tail -n1)
  if [ -n "$usage" ]; then
    tot=$(printf '%s' "$usage" | jq -r '(.input_tokens // 0) + (.cache_read_input_tokens // 0) + (.cache_creation_input_tokens // 0) + (.output_tokens // 0)' 2>/dev/null)
    case "$tot" in ''|*[!0-9]*) tot='' ;; esac
    [ -n "$tot" ] && pct=$(awk -v t="$tot" -v s="$size" 'BEGIN{printf "%.0f", (t/s)*100}')
  fi
fi
if [ -n "$pct" ]; then ctx=$(awk -v p="$pct" 'BEGIN{printf "%.0f%%", p}'); else ctx='--'; fi
printf '\033[2;36m%s\033[0m \033[2m|\033[0m \033[2;33m%s\033[0m \033[2m|\033[0m \033[2;35mctx %s\033[0m\n' "$model" "$backend" "$ctx"
